items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: He was a very fine trombone man. He helped me out a lot.

ctx.x: Yeah, I wish I'd heard him on trombone, he must have been one of the better.
So you know I heard a lot of them, thought I'd do that, yeah. I can imitate him pretty nice. He was a very fine trombone man. He helped me out a lot.
Did he help you out at home or?
